property_summary: For every call to transfer with a non-empty _tos, C always reverts if any callee call to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) fails (so the call does not return true), whereas the mutant that omits checking the callee success may return true even when a callee reverts; the test deploys a helper that can be set to revert to trigger this difference.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after each external call so failed calls don't revert; transfer returns true even if some calls fail, changing observable return on failing calldata.
